page.layout: One page of text. Above the text, centred: a circular portrait medallion with the engraved label "PAVL.ÆGINETA". Below it: one paragraph of running text. Below the text: a decorative ornament, then the signature. The running head is at the top. The page number is at the top right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: PAULUS Ægineta, mirabili ardore discendi percitus, dif-
ficillimas peregrinationes sustinuit, ut medicam artem cogno-
scere. Libros reliquit in medicina, non sua inventione, sed Ga-
leni imitatione, cuius veluti simia dici potest. A Ioanne filio Se-
rapionis allegatur simpliciter Pauli nomine, & similiter ab aliis
Medicis. Scripsit lib. 7. Græcos, collatione vetustorum exem-
plariū restitutos, & quibusdam in locis auctos, per Hieronymū
Gemusceum impressos Basileæ, qui fuerunt versi à Ioane Guin-
terio Andernaco, & ab Albano Tornio, quos prior commenta-
riis illustravit. Aeginetæ libros Henricus Stephanus, cum aliis
præcipuorum medicorum libris excudit. Floruit anno mundi

page.notes: The medallion portrait is an engraving of Paulus Aegineta with the circular inscription "PAVL.ÆGINETA". The ornament below the text is a decorative woodcut strip with figures and scrolls and carries no text. The first line of the paragraph is set in spaced capitals, and the paragraph has no separate heading. The text is clear throughout. No doubtful readings.
